records.title: DIMoE-Adapters: Dynamic Expert Evolution for Continual Learning in Vision-Language Models
records.reason: DIMoE-Adapters evolves adapter experts for continual learning in vision-language models. Its experiments concern adaptation/generalization across tasks, not reduced inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: A Scalable Recipe on SuperMUC-NG Phase 2: Efficient Large-Scale Training of Language Models
records.reason: This work evaluates tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism for large-scale LLM training on SuperMUC-NG. The studied throughput and scaling are training throughput, not inference/serving.

records.title: AccelSync: Verifying Synchronization Coverage in Accelerator Pipeline Programs
records.reason: AccelSync formalizes and verifies synchronization coverage in accelerator pipeline programs to detect races. It is a correctness/verification tool; the primary text does not present a method improving LLM inference performance or serving.

records.title: CAMAL: Improving Attention Alignment and Faithfulness with Segmentation Masks
records.reason: CAMAL uses segmentation masks for attention supervision in vision-model training and evaluates attention alignment/faithfulness. It is a training/interpretability contribution, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond Bag-of-Patches: Learning Global Layout via Textual Supervision for Late-Interaction Visual Document Retrieval
records.reason: This work improves global-layout representation for visual-document retrieval with a late-interaction retriever. Its evaluation concerns retrieval quality and visual document layout, not LLM inference or serving.
